problem.title: How Vehicle Owners Are Losing Value Due to Headlight Damage
stats: MOT fail risk from degraded light output
paragraphs: Headlights are among the most vulnerable components on any vehicle. UV radiation yellows polycarbonate lenses within three to five years of unprotected use, reducing light output and creating a direct MOT failure risk. Rock chips and road debris crack or pit the lens surface — damage that is impossible to reverse without full unit replacement at £150-£400 per headlight. Chemical contaminants from road spray, brake dust, and cleaning products accelerate surface hazing that no restoration kit permanently corrects.

Standard remedies are costly and short-lived. Restoration polishing removes the top degraded layer, but without an immediate UV barrier, yellowing returns within 6-12 months. Replacement headlights for premium vehicles cost £300-£800 per pair including fitment labour. Fleet operators managing 20+ vehicles face compounding replacement cycles that absorb maintenance budgets and increase vehicle downtime. Detailing professionals who restore headlights without offering a permanent solution face the same repeat bookings — a reactive service loop that fails both the vehicle and the customer relationship.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything B2B buyers ask before partnering with a PPF supplier.
items: What is headlight paint protection film?

A clear, self-healing polyurethane film applied to headlight lenses to block UV radiation, prevent rock chip damage, and eliminate surface hazing. Platinum Car Films specialises in professional PPF installation with certified technicians trained in headlight applications.
How does headlight PPF prevent yellowing?

The polyurethane formula absorbs 99% of UV radiation before it reaches the polycarbonate lens, stopping the oxidation process that causes yellowing. Unlike restoration kits that treat existing yellowing, headlight PPF prevents degradation from the day of installation.
How long does headlight PPF last?

10-year [industry-standard automotive PPF] warranty under normal driving conditions. Most owners keep vehicles 5-8 years, making headlight PPF effective lifetime protection for the full ownership period.
How much does headlight PPF cost?

Headlight-only installation: typically £150-£300 per pair, including surface preparation and certified application. Front-end protection bundles (headlights, bumper, hood) are available at combined rates. Financing options available on full-vehicle installations.
Does headlight PPF affect light output or MOT compliance?

No. The film is optically transparent with zero tint or haze — full light output is preserved. MOT compliance is not affected by correctly applied, clear automotive PPF. Platinum Car Films uses only [automotive-grade optically clear] film on all headlight work.
Why choose headlight PPF over restoration?

Restoration polishing removes the degraded surface layer but provides no UV barrier — yellowing returns within 6-12 months. Headlight PPF prevents degradation for 10 years. Over a typical ownership period, PPF is more cost-effective than two restoration cycles.
